name: operator-console-web
description: Cloudflare Worker runtime shell for the Operator Console web surface.

scripts.build:staging: WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home node ../../scripts/run-worker-staging-build.mjs OPERATOR_CONSOLE_APP_API_SHARED_SECRET SENTRY_DSN -- vite build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && node ../../scripts/verify-worker-deploy-config.mjs dist/operator_console_web/wrangler.json APP_API=app-api && node ../../scripts/run-wrangler-command.mjs deploy --config dist/operator_console_web/wrangler.json
scripts.preview: pnpm build && WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home vite preview
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:worker
